question: Where are a golf course positioned within 170 kilometers relative to Montefiore Medical Center - Wakefield Campus, Bronx, NY in the southwest direction?
sql: WITH ref_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Montefiore Medical Center - Wakefield Campus%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bronx%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT poi_name AS name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois, ref_point WHERE pois.leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, ref_point.geometry::geography, 170000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ref_point.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5 UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, NULL AS addr_state, NULL AS addr_city FROM parks, ref_point WHERE parks.leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(parks.geometry::geography, ref_point.geometry::geography, 170000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ref_point.geometry, parks.geometry)) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
